Get Collection Mappings.description: Fetches all mappings in an OCL collection, e.g. to map form answers to standard codes.

Search Concepts In Source.description: Searches concepts in an organization's source by keyword.

Get Concept By ID.description: Fetches a single concept from a source by its concept ID.

Get Mappings For Concept.description: Lists the mappings (e.g. to ICD-10 or SNOMED) for one concept in a source.

Get Concepts Updated Since.description: Fetches concepts changed since a date, for incremental sync of a terminology into a local system.

Cascade Concept Hierarchy.description: Resolves a concept and its child concepts and mappings using $cascade, e.g. a question with its answers.

List Source Versions.description: Lists the released versions of a source, to pin integrations to a specific version.

List Concepts In Collection.description: Lists concepts in a specific version of an organization's collection.

List Organization Sources.description: Lists all sources owned by an OCL organization.
